name: The Nice Neighborhood Lady
source:
The weirdly nice neighborhood lady is offering you a place to stay and you are a serial killer on the run.

Definitely nothing wrong with her . . . right?

[From [url=https://foppydoodles.itch.io/the-nice-neighborhood-lady]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
邻里那位好心得有些古怪的女士向你提供了住处，而你是一名正在逃亡的连环杀手。

她肯定没什么问题……对吧？

（摘自[url=https://foppydoodles.itch.io/the-nice-neighborhood-lady]itch.io[/url]）
